# Logo Stinger

**Cover › Stinger** · v1.0.0 · 60 frames at 30 fps (36–100)

A badge pops in, spins and grows to fill the frame with a word on it, then shrinks back and pops away to show the next scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/stinger@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/stinger@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Branded scene changes
- Streams and esports
- YouTube segment breaks

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import stinger from './transitions/04-cover/stinger/stinger';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(stinger, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 60 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | `"NEXT"` |  | Word on the badge. |
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | Badge colour; use the incoming scene's background colour. |
| `textColor` | color | `"#111111"` |  | Word colour. |
| `hold` | number | `0.25` | 0–0.5 | Share of the transition spent fully covered (the word is readable here). |
